format.title: Output format
format.description: Auto reuses original producer files; otherwise writes a 2D table as CSV or other tensors as NPY. PDB/mmCIF require an original file.

filename.title: Filename stem
filename.description: Optional basename without extension. Leave empty to reuse same-task original files without copying.

include_labels.title: Include table labels
include_labels.description: CSV/TSV header and row labels. NPY preserves array dtype and shape; labels remain in the workflow data.

buffer_mb.title: Write buffer (MiB)
buffer_mb.description: NPY writing buffer; does not replace the execution memory budget.
